Plot a taxon co-occurrence network

Source: R/mp_network.R
mp_network.Rd

Builds a correlation network between taxa and renders it with ggraph. Correlations are computed on centred log-ratio (CLR) coordinates by default; edges are filtered by correlation strength and adjusted p-value. SparCC / SPIEC-EASI inference is available when the SpiecEasi package is installed.

Usage

mp_network(
  object,
  method = c("spearman", "pearson", "sparcc", "spiec-easi"),
  tax.level = NULL,
  top.n = 50,
  cor.threshold = 0.6,
  p.threshold = 0.05,
  p.adjust.method = "BH",
  layout = c("fr", "stress", "kk", "circle"),
  node.color.by = NULL,
  node.size.by = c("abundance", "degree"),
  edge.color.by = c("sign", "none"),
  label.nodes = FALSE,
  label.size = 2.5,
  palette = NULL,
  theme = NULL,
  plot.title = NULL,
  plot.subtitle = NULL,
  plot.caption = NULL,
  font.size = getOption("micropubr.font.size", 11),
  interactive = FALSE,
  verbose = getOption("micropubr.verbose", FALSE)
)

Arguments

object

A phyloseq::phyloseq object.

method

Association method: "spearman", "pearson", "sparcc" or "spiec-easi". The latter two require the SpiecEasi package.

tax.level

Optional rank to agglomerate to before building the network.

top.n

Keep only the top.n most-abundant taxa (for tractability).

cor.threshold

Minimum absolute correlation to draw an edge.

p.threshold

Maximum adjusted p-value for an edge (correlation methods only).

p.adjust.method

Multiple-testing correction (default "BH").

layout

ggraph layout: "fr", "stress", "kk" or "circle".

node.color.by

Taxonomic rank used to colour nodes.

node.size.by

Size nodes by "abundance" or "degree".

edge.color.by

Colour edges by "sign" (default) or "none".

label.nodes

Label nodes with their taxon name.

label.size

Node-label font size.

palette

Palette name or colour vector.

theme

A ggplot2 theme; defaults to a clean void theme.

plot.title, plot.subtitle, plot.caption

Optional labels.

font.size

Base font size.

interactive

If TRUE, return an interactive plotly widget instead of a static ggplot (requires plotly). Experimental for network plots: ggraph edge geoms translate only partially. See mp_alpha().

verbose

Print the steps used.

Value

A ggplot/ggraph object, or a plotly widget when interactive = TRUE.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data(GlobalPatterns, package = "phyloseq")
gp <- phyloseq::tax_glom(GlobalPatterns, "Genus")
mp_network(gp, top.n = 60, node.color.by = "Phylum")
} # }
